name: Avatar
description: Displays a circular image, often used for user profiles, with an optional decorative gradient border.
usage: Import the Avatar component: `import { Avatar } from '@levain/ui-react';`
Use `showBorder={false}` to hide the gradient border.
Apply additional styling to the wrapper via `className` or the image via `imageClassName`.
examples:
```tsx
// Basic Avatar with default size and border
<Avatar src="/path/to/image.png" alt="User Avatar" />
```

```tsx
// Smaller Avatar without border
<Avatar src="/path/to/image.png" alt="User Avatar" size={32} showBorder={false} />
```

```tsx
// Avatar with additional wrapper classes
<Avatar src="/path/to/image.png" alt="User Avatar" size={128} className="mt-4" />
```
design: Use avatars to represent users or entities visually.
Ensure the `alt` text is descriptive for accessibility.
Use consistent sizing for avatars within the same context.
The gradient border is decorative; use `showBorder={false}` if it clashes with the surrounding UI.
accessibility: Requires descriptive `alt` text for screen readers.
Ensure sufficient contrast if text is placed near or over the avatar.

props.name: src
props.description: The source URL for the avatar image.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the avatar image, crucial for accessibility.

props.name: size
props.description: Predefined avatar size ('xs': 24px, 'sm': 32px, 'md': 48px, 'lg': 64px, 'xl': 84px) or 'custom' to use customSize.

props.name: customSize
props.description: The size in pixels when size prop is set to 'custom'.

props.name: className
props.description: Optional className to apply to the outer wrapper div.

props.name: imageClassName
props.description: Optional className to apply directly to the next/image component.

props.name: showBorder
props.description: Whether to display the gradient border around the avatar.
